description: Check whether a Steam game has been delisted — and when it went A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

game.description: The game to look up: a name, a Steam store URL or a numeric app id, in one field. A name is matched against every game ever seen in the weekly Steam snapshots, including ones Steam's own search no longer finds, and up to 8 matches come back each with a status of listed, delisted, upcoming, gone or unknown.

name: delisted_games
title: Delisted Games
